note: Adair County Conservation park 1.5 mi SE of Bridgewater on 35-acre Mormon Trail Lake (170-acre park). Two campgrounds: five electric sites on the north (beach) side above the swim beach, and 13 electric plus 5 non-electric sites across the lake to the south. Modern restroom/shower house, shelter, playground, unsupervised swimming, kayaking and sailing, fishing. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $20 (fee schedule effective 2021, still posted), showers. Sites now 23 (5 north + 18 south). Booking changed from reservable online to FCFS (county page; Mormon Trail isn't on Adair's booking list). Note cleaned. Lakeview stands on the north loop.
flags: BOOKING CONTRADICTED: stored booking reservable:true / platform operator (from the old note, 'Reservable online (mycountyparks.com)') conflicts with the county's camping page, which says 'Camping is available on a first-come first-serve basis.' Adair's mycountyparks facility list carries Lake Orient Campground only. The result writes reservable false, fcfs always; the derived group is not protected.

WATERFRONT: lakeview stands. The north (beach) loop's five back-in pads (Esri, ~41.2438,-94.6326) sit ~75-80 m from the lake. Open mowed lawn with scattered young trees lies between, giving a clear sightline, but so do the park road along the shore and the swim beach / day-use area just east. Not on-water (road plus day use between; AWH 2026-11-01). The 35-acre lake is lake-size. The south campground's 13 electric + 5 non-electric sites could not be located: the peninsula road ends in a turnaround ~35 m from shore behind brush, and the south loop runs under timber, with no pads visible. A county photo shows RVs on a grassy slope above trees, seen from across the water; it is unclear which loop. The stored waterfront_evidence is only a commit reference.

PIN: the stored pin 41.23950,-94.63320 is in timber inside the south loop road, ~480 m south of the north pads. The south campground's pads were not seen on imagery, so it may or may not be near the 18 south sites; no move proposed. Google's park point (41.23958,-94.63732) is the Delta Ave entrance.
RATE DATE: the $20 schedule is dated effective July 21, 2021, but it is the county's current posted schedule (local entry, so no 2024+ gate). Electric amperage not posted.
Phone 641-743-6450 confirmed (adaircounty.iowa.gov/conservation/). Website mycountyparks park page OK. Google 4.7 stars / 86 reviews.
